newsItems.title: Harvard Law dropout raises $6M for Blue Voice to build a ‘Harvey for police officers’
newsItems.summary: Blue Voice is trained on department-specific laws, local ordinances, protocols, and guidelines that general-purpose AI tools can't access on the public internet.

newsItems.title: The Pentagon now has its own version of ChatGPT and Grok
